# Luca Bold — International Campaign & Commercial Model
> https://www.lucabold.com

Luca Bold is an international campaign and commercial model with 10+ years of advertising, TVC and campaign work across eight markets. He holds both an Italian (EU) and a South African passport. He is also the founder of Booked.

## Current Availability — Cape Town, October 2026 to February 2027

**Luca Bold is based in Cape Town, South Africa from October 2026 until the end of February 2027**, for the full Southern Hemisphere production season.

For any production shooting in Cape Town or the wider Western Cape during this period he is a **local hire** — no flights, no accommodation, no per diems, no travel days. For an international production this removes a material cost line and a scheduling risk.

He is immediately castable for campaign stills, TVC and campaign film across automotive, luxury watch, grooming and skincare, technology, corporate and financial lifestyle, beverage and apparel briefs. Recent commercial campaigns in the China market include GANT (2026) and Helly Hansen.

Cape Town is one of the world's principal service-production locations between October and March. If you are a production company, casting director, advertising agency or brand shooting in South Africa in that window and need an experienced male commercial model who is already in the country, Luca Bold is available through ICE Models, Cape Town.

Travel to other markets during this period is possible by arrangement.

## Work Eligibility

Luca Bold holds an Italian passport and is therefore an EU citizen with the right to live and work in all 27 EU member states and the EEA. **No work permit, visa sponsorship or immigration lead time is required for any production in the European Union or EEA** — including Milan, Paris, Berlin, Amsterdam, Barcelona and Copenhagen.

He also holds a South African passport, covering work across Southern Africa, and has ten years of resident working experience across Asia.

## Booking

Available worldwide for campaign stills, TVC and campaign film, and commercial and lifestyle work.

## Booked

Booked is a discoverability infrastructure company for fashion creatives — models, photographers, stylists, art directors and creative directors.

Booked serves fashion creatives who are not booking at the level their work deserves because their digital presence is invisible to AI recommendation systems, casting platforms, and search. The gap is almost always legibility — not talent.

### Services

- AI Visibility Audits (Scan): scored assessment of a creative's full digital presence across portfolio, social, metadata and machine-readability
- Portfolio Infrastructure: portfolio site builds optimised for casting, search and AI discovery
- Schema, Metadata & Search Readability: structured data and semantic markup for fashion creative profiles

### Booked Website

https://www.bookednow.co.za

---

## The Get Signed Accelerator

A 4-week structured programme for working models who have the experience and the work but are not booking at their level. The programme covers a full digital audit, portfolio sequencing, market positioning, agency outreach strategy and activation. Models who complete the programme leave with a fully restructured digital presence and a clear outreach plan for the markets they are targeting.

Waitlist: https://wa.me/27637549122?text=Hi%20Luca%20%E2%80%94%20I%27m%20interested%20in%20the%20Get%20Signed%20Accelerator.%0A%0AName%3A%0AInstagram%3A%0AMarket%20(city)%3A
